parameters.text:
=Write a bilingual blog post for Accez.cloud about: {{ $json.topic }}.

ABOUT ACCEZ (use only these facts, never invent capabilities):
Accez is an all-in-one property operations platform for Saudi Arabia, in Arabic and English. It covers: reservations and channel sync across 400+ booking channels; rental and sale properties; owner management, statements and payouts; sales and developer projects; contracts and e-signing; hotels and serviced apartments; work orders and maintenance; a service provider marketplace; resident communications; and marketing campaigns and analytics. It serves property managers, owners, developers, hotel and serviced-apartment operators, and service providers. Write only about property, rental, hospitality and facilities operations, never describe Accez as serving any other industry.

CRITICAL FRONTMATTER RULES: ALL string values MUST be wrapped in double quotes, even if they contain colons, apostrophes, or quotes. Escape any internal double quotes with a backslash. Do not use unescaped colons inside string values.

Start the file with this exact MDX frontmatter (replace the bracketed parts):

---
title: "[English title here, no colons]"
titleAr: "[Arabic title here, no colons]"
metaTitle: "[English search-result title, 50-60 characters, includes the primary keyword, no colons]"
metaTitleAr: "[Arabic search-result title, no colons]"
metaDescription: "[English search-result description, 140-155 characters, includes the primary keyword, ends with a reason to click, no colons]"
metaDescriptionAr: "[Arabic search-result description, 140-155 characters, no colons]"
primaryKeyword: "[the single search query this post targets, in English, lowercase]"
excerpt: "[English excerpt here, no colons]"
excerptAr: "[Arabic excerpt here, no colons]"
date: "{{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}"
author: "Accez Team"
authorAr: "فريق أكسيز"
coverImage: "/images/blog/pm-default.jpg"
coverImageAlt: "[plain descriptive alt text, describe what is literally in the image, no keyword stuffing, no colons]"
category: "Industry Insights"
categoryAr: "رؤى الصناعة"
tags: ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3", "tag4", "tag5"]
tagsAr: ["وسم1", "وسم2", "وسم3", "وسم4", "وسم5"]
---

After the closing --- of the frontmatter, output the article body following this EXACT structure in this EXACT order. Do NOT add a title heading (#) at the top.

=== STRUCTURE (follow exactly) ===

1. SUMMARY BLOCK: The very first thing after the frontmatter. A single blockquote, every line beginning with "> ". 60-90 words. It must answer the article's core question completely on its own, so that someone who reads only this block still gets a correct and useful answer. Include at least two concrete specifics (a number, a percentage, a regulation name, or a timeframe). Do not mention Accez in this block. Do not write the word "Summary" as a label, just the blockquote.

2. HOOK PARAGRAPH (no heading): 2-3 sentences in plain prose presenting a relatable problem or paradox that property managers face. Must hook immediately. Never start with generic phrases like "In the world of real estate..." or "In today's market...".

3. TRANSITION PARAGRAPH (no heading): One paragraph expanding on the problem.

4. A '##' section that goes deep on what breaks and why. INVENT a specific heading for it about this article's topic; do NOT reuse the words of this instruction as the heading, and never write a generic heading like 'A Deep Dive into What Breaks and Why'. Write mostly prose paragraphs. Bullet points are allowed only when listing 4+ items. Bold maximum 2-3 critical phrases in this section. Include at least one real statistic with a source.

5. A '##' section on what the best operators do differently. INVENT a specific heading for it about this article's topic; do NOT reuse the words of this instruction. Use ### subheadings for each point. Each subsection must be 2-3 paragraphs of prose, NOT bullet lists. Bold maximum 2-3 critical phrases total in this section. Include at least one real statistic with a source.

6. A '##' section specific to Saudi Arabia. INVENT a specific heading naming the topic and the Kingdom. Must reference at least TWO of these specifically: Vision 2030, Ejar compliance, WhatsApp adoption (77%+ rate in KSA), GASTAT statistics, Mada/SADAD payments, seasonal demand around Hajj/Umrah, Balady or municipality licensing. Write in flowing prose, not lists. Include real statistics with sources. This section MUST contain exactly one markdown link to an authoritative external source, an official government, regulator, or statistics body (for example ejar.sa, gastat.gov.sa, vision2030.gov.sa, momrah.gov.sa). Link only to a page you are confident exists; if unsure, link to the organisation's homepage.

7. ## How Accez.Cloud Helps You [topic-relevant verb] MANDATORY section. This is the first time Accez.Cloud is introduced in the article. List 5-6 specific Accez.Cloud features as bullet points, drawn ONLY from the capability list in "ABOUT ACCEZ" above. Each bullet must directly solve a problem mentioned earlier in the article. End the section with one closing sentence about growth.

8. ## Frequently Asked Questions EXACTLY 4 questions. Each question is a ### heading phrased exactly as a property manager would type it into Google. Each answer is 40-70 words of plain prose, answering directly in the first sentence before adding any detail. No bullets inside answers.

9. ## Key Takeaways EXACTLY 6 to 8 bullet points summarizing the article's main points.

10. If the article touches rent, deposits, service charges, contracts, taxes, or regulatory compliance, add one italic line here: *This article is general information for property operators and is not legal, tax, or financial advice. Confirm specifics with a qualified professional.* If the topic does not touch those areas, skip this line entirely.

11. CTA line: One single line ending with [Visit portal.accez.cloud](https://portal.accez.cloud)

12. <!-- AR --> on its own line.

13. Complete Arabic translation following the EXACT same structure (steps 1-11 in Arabic), including the summary blockquote, the FAQ section, the external authoritative link, and the disclaimer line if applicable. Same rules: no title heading, summary blockquote first, then hook, ## and ### only, prose-first, identical section order, mandatory "How Accez.Cloud Helps You" section before the FAQ, Key Takeaways after the FAQ, CTA at the end. Use these EXACT Arabic headings, do not translate them yourself: the FAQ heading must be "## الأسئلة الشائعة" and the takeaways heading must be "## أبرز النقاط". Never translate "Key Takeaways" literally, "الوجبات الرئيسية" means "main meals" and is wrong. All other Arabic headings must be natural Arabic written for a Saudi property professional, not word-for-word translations of the English.

=== TONE & FORMATTING RULES ===

- Write like a knowledgeable industry consultant who understands Saudi property management deeply.
- Never introduce Accez.Cloud before section 7 in either language.
- Use ## and ### only, NEVER use #### or deeper.
- The ONLY markdown the site renders is: ## and ### headings, "- " bullets, "1. " numbered lists, **bold**, *italic*, [links](url), and "> " blockquotes. NEVER output tables, images, code blocks, or horizontal rules, they will appear as raw characters on the page.
- For unordered lists ALWAYS use `-` (hyphen), NEVER `*` (asterisk).
- NEVER invent links to other blog posts. Do not add a "Related Articles" section and do not link to any /blog/... URL. You cannot know which articles exist, and invented links produce 404 pages. The website generates its own related-posts section automatically. The ONLY links allowed are: the one authoritative external source in section 6, and the portal.accez.cloud CTA.
- Bold a maximum of 2-3 phrases per section, only the most important ones. Do not over-bold.
- Include at least one real statistic with a source per major section (sections 4, 5, 6). Attribute every statistic to a named organisation. If you are not confident a statistic is real, write the point without a number rather than inventing one.
- Opening must hook immediately. No generic openers.
- Never claim Accez has a capability not listed in "ABOUT ACCEZ".
- Length: 1500-1800 words English, 1500-1800 words Arabic.

=== OUTPUT RULES ===

Output raw markdown only. No commentary, no code fences, no explanation before or after.

parameters.content:
## 1. Manual Trigger
Click 'Test workflow' to start the pipeline.

## 2. Read Google Sheets
Reads rows from **Topics** sheet. Code finds first row where column B = 'pending'.

## 3. AI Content Generation
Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) generates bilingual EN/AR blog post with MDX frontmatter.

## 4. Clean Output
Strips code fences and extracts the **article title** from frontmatter for Unsplash search.

## 5. Unsplash Image Fetch
**Search Unsplash** with article title → **Process Result** extracts the first image URL and updates `coverImage` in the MDX frontmatter.

Fallback: `/images/blog/pm-default.jpg` if no result.

**If Has Image** branches: TRUE → download + push image + article. FALSE → skip straight to article push.

## 6. Download & Push Image
Downloads the Unsplash image as binary and pushes to `public/images/blog/<slug>.jpg`.

## 7. Push Blog Post
Creates `content/blog/<slug>.md` on main. Error branches to failure node.

## 8. Conditional Sheet Update
Only runs if article push succeeds. Marks row as 'used' with today's date.

## 9. Output
Success: status + URL + topic.
Error: failure details, sheet unchanged.
